title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Infrastructure Works variant
description: Variant for infrastructure / civil-works defect capture — roads, drainage, linkways, bridges, tunnels, culverts. Adds the asset-class identifier, chainage (km marker for linear assets), and structure ID (for point assets) so defects can be located along long linear works without relying on text-only location.

asset_class.description: Class of infrastructure asset the defect sits on. Drives which inspection regime / asset-management system the defect feeds into. Required — every infrastructure photo has an identifiable asset class.

chainage_km.description: Chainage / linear-asset position in kilometres along the route. Empty for point assets (bridges, manholes). Decimals supported (e.g. 12.347).

structure_id.description: Point-asset identifier (bridge / tunnel / culvert / manhole reference). Free text. Empty for linear-asset defects identified by chainage.
